_meta.openai/toolInvocation/invoked: Done: Ask the person to approve

description: Make the person's approval page for an agreed deal, as buyer or seller, and get its approval_url. Send the URL to the person and wait. The buyer's agent already got it from market_make_offer or market_counter; call this for a new link or as the seller. Never open it yourself and never approve for the person. The deal binds only when both the buyer's and the seller's person approve.

deal_id.description: A deal_id from market_make_offer or market_deal_log.

idempotency_key.description: Optional: a unique string you make for this call, such as a UUID. Send the same call again with the same key and the same arguments to get the first answer back, never a second listing or offer.

owner_key.description: The owner_key from the person's first market_make_offer or market_create_listing (or from market_sign_in). Keep it private to this conversation.

name: market_request_approval

next_action.description: What to do next, as a code: the same advice as next_step.

next_step.description: What to do next, in one or two sentences.

title: Ask the person to approve
